title: WADE: An LSTM-Based Anomaly Detection Engine for WebAssembly Applications
abstract: arXiv:2610.31984v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: WebAssembly (Wasm) enables near-native performance for web applications through a portable and sandboxed execution model. However, its limited runtime protection mechanisms (e.g., the lack of stack canaries and address space layout randomization (ASLR)) leave Wasm applications vulnerable to traditional attacks.   We present WADE (WebAssembly Anomaly Detection Engine), a system that detects anomalous runtime behaviors in browser-executed WebAssembly applications. WADE monitors function-level execution traces collected under benign conditions and trains a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network to learn the normal execution behavior of each application. At runtime, the model flags deviations from these learned patterns as potential attacks. Unlike signature-based approaches, WADE builds application-specific behavioral models, enabling detection of both known and previously unseen attacks without per-vulnerability signatures. translated_title: WADE：一种基于LSTM的WebAssembly应用异常检测引擎
translated_abstract: WebAssembly (Wasm) 通过可移植且沙箱化的执行模型，为 Web 应用提供接近原生的运行性能。然而，其有限的运行时保护机制（例如缺乏栈保护金丝雀和地址空间布局随机化 (ASLR)）使 Wasm 应用容易遭受传统攻击。我们提出了 WADE（WebAssembly 异常检测引擎），这是一个用于检测浏览器中执行的 WebAssembly 应用异常运行时行为的系统。WADE 监控在良性条件下收集的函数级执行轨迹，并训练长短期记忆网络 (LSTM) 来学习每个应用的正常执行行为。在运行时，该模型将偏离这些已学习模式的行为标记为潜在攻击。与基于签名的方案不同，WADE 构建针对特定应用的行为模型，无需针对每个漏洞的签名即可检测已知和前所未见的攻击。我们对……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: WADE 提出了一种基于 LSTM 的异常检测引擎，通过学习 WebAssembly 应用在良性条件下的正常函数级执行轨迹，无需漏洞签名即可在浏览器运行时检测已知和未知的攻击行为。
